title: Platform registry and governed recovery
text: Governed Postgres models can live on an environment box without retired cloud coordinates. The environment database.location owns the box/Aurora switch. Box db-admin setup needs only the model database_name, the provisioned DSN file and the environment's servers[0].mac_host: it writes its own SSH hop through that Mac host to ~/.yoke/ssh/config, creates and authorizes the operator key and pins the VM host key, and never edits ~/.ssh/config; Aurora setup requires its output names, and cloud authority readers refuse a missing stack with recovery.
